observed_source_mechanisms.finding: generic_activation_patch implements a clean-vs-corrupted counterfactual intervention loop: cached clean activations are inserted into a corrupted forward run through a forward hook and a user-supplied metric measures output recovery. This is directly relevant as a mechanistic matched-intervention donor, but by itself does not establish F2 GWT semantic uptake.

run_with_cache/get_caching_hooks provide selective activation capture and run_with_hooks provides scoped forward interventions; cache entries are detached tensors and hooks can be reset after the run.

legacy HookedTransformer.from_pretrained defaults fold_ln=true, center_writing_weights=true, center_unembed=true and fold_value_biases=true; these transformations are intended to preserve relevant computation but change the represented weights/logits conventions and are therefore unsuitable as an unqualified exact-byte/model-identity proof surface for F2.

TransformerBridge.boot_transformers is the preferred v3 path and documents raw HF weights by default; it retains original_model, wraps it with architecture adapters/hook points, and only enters HookedTransformer-equivalent compatibility numerics when compatibility mode is explicitly enabled. This substantially mitigates the legacy-loader provenance concern.

explicit Qwen3 conversion support exists; repository search also shows Qwen/Qwen2/Qwen3 surfaces. This is compatibility evidence only, not evidence that the exact F2 target checkpoint/runtime has been reproduced.

hypothesis: TransformerLens v3 TransformerBridge can serve as an offline/local mechanistic-intervention measurement donor for WP507/J-Space falsification: capture a fixed activation from a clean/control run, intervene at one named hook during an otherwise identity-bound matched run, and compare a predeclared downstream output digest/metric.
counterhypothesis: Even with raw-HF-weight Bridge mode, adapter hook placement, eager-attention forcing, tokenizer/BOS behavior, device/dtype, or instrumentation itself may create numerical/semantic differences. Therefore an F2 experiment must first prove baseline output equivalence for the exact target model/input/config and bind checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build identities before interpreting any intervention delta.

f2_fit.nonduplicate_with_current_parallel_work: Complements pyvene native intervention scouting, DoWhy causal-refutation work, and OpenTelemetry trace-attribution work by adding activation-patching / mechanistic localization as a separate falsification surface.

next_evidence_gate.test: On one exact local target checkpoint, compare uninstrumented HF baseline vs TransformerBridge raw-HF mode on identical token IDs/dtype/device/eager-attention configuration. Require deterministic output-digest/logit tolerance agreement first; then run one predeclared single-site patch with a matched no-patch control. Reject interpretation if baseline equivalence fails or any identity/provenance field is unknown.
next_evidence_gate.acceptance: Baseline-equivalence evidence plus a fully bound intervention/control receipt; no GWT/J-Space/runtime credit is granted merely from source compatibility.
